subject.summary: Narrow-body 964 Carrera 2 coupé, interpreted as a measured holographic coachwork study. Documented overall dimensions and wheelbase; photograph-traced roofline and inferred compound surfaces. Later Cup-style mirrors and five-spoke wheels. The active rear spoiler deploys after assembly.

facts.note: Narrow-body coupé selected to represent the requested generation; not a Turbo or a particular chassis.

970×647 side image; axle centres (234,468) and (731,474). Trace fitted to 2.272 m wheelbase gives 4.141 m image length and 1.307 m height. Depth/perspective corrected to documented 4.250 m overall length; compound curvature inferred from three-quarter photos.
Broad five-spoke silhouette measured visually; not an exact wheel CAD model.
Presentation travel and hinge angle are visual approximations, not service measurements.
